title: Khamosh Hai Alqama
body:
khamosh hai alqama ki mauje
faza may bhi maut ka samaa hai
rida-e-zainab tera mohafiz
ukhadti saanso ke darmiyan hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
hawa'on ke rukh badal rahe hai
qayaam darya se hat rahe hai
kisi ke teywar bata rahe hai
ke toot padne ko aasman hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam ki paykaan to kheynch lenge
hussain chashm-e-jari se lekin
khalish ka ek teer aur bhi hai
jo qalb-e-abbas may nihaan hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina bibi ki tashnagi ka
jigar pe ab tak hai daagh baaqi
wahin wahin mashk bhi milegi
alam jari ka jahan jahan hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
ba chashm-e-purnam ba-waqte rehlat
ali ne jin baazu'on ko chooma
kahin wo baazu qalam huye hai
kahin pe in may reesma hai
khamosh hai…
<<DIVIDER>>
lahoo lahoo paykar e tamanna
qareeb mashkeeza e sakina
gira hai rehwaar se wo aise
kahin pe baazu kahin nishan hai
khamosh hai…
author: Shahid Jafer
